blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The obstruction of justice case filed against Sen. Robin Padilla is an independent local legal proceeding that operates separately from the International Criminal Court (ICC), a Department of Justice (DOJ) official said on Thursday. Undersecretary Ian Norman Dato, head of the DOJ’s Law Enforcement Cluster, dismissed Padilla’s claim that the case cannot proceed because it stems from an ICC arrest warrant. When asked about allegations that Padilla helped Senator Ronald Dela Rosa evade arrest following the issuance of an ICC arrest warrant against Dela Rosa, Dato declined to discuss specific evidence, emphasizing that the evaluation rests entirely with […]...
